purpose: Single-entry Google Drive routing map for TAKY durable working/source/review/handoff/archive material. GitHub remains canonical governance authority.

REVIEWS_C2S.name: 20_REVIEWS_C2S
REVIEWS_C2S.purpose: Derived review results, C2S intake/review evidence and review-control artifacts

HANDOFF.name: 80_HANDOFF
HANDOFF.purpose: Historical/resume handoff packages; not canonical authority

ARCHIVE.name: 90_ARCHIVE
ARCHIVE.purpose: Raw exports, superseded/legacy material, incomplete duplicates, old governance patches

routing_rules: Do not create a new TAKY sibling root when an existing role folder fits.
Preserve Drive file IDs when reorganizing; prefer move/rename over copy/delete.
Do not delete same-name items based on name alone; inspect content, parent, date and authority first.
Raw conversation/share exports belong under ARCHIVE/RAW_CHAT_EXPORTS, not My Drive root.
Handoff artifacts belong under HANDOFF and remain recovery evidence, not source of truth.
C2S/review artifacts belong under REVIEWS_C2S; downstream project implementation artifacts belong under PROJECTS.
NotebookLM material is legacy/optional and excluded from the default active route.
Shared legacy folders with external permissions must not be silently moved or permission-mutated during cleanup.
Current mobile app source code lives in GitHub product repositories; Drive project roots hold design/assets/review/QA/release-handoff/reference material, not a competing current source tree.

Local execution MAY use OS/LOCAL_DRIVE_WORKSPACE.md with drive-sync as a Google Drive Computer backup mirror; this does not create a new Drive canonical root or move Git repositories into synced storage.
